## PositionSnapshot.get() method

Returns the captured pair for a node from this parse, or undefined for a foreign node. If either upstream observation failed, throws the captured InputError without changing the successfully parsed File. Use nodePos or nodeEnd to request a live, independent bound from current edited fields.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(node: Node): NodePositions | undefined;
```
